item.title: Should not Food Modification be the first line of management?
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, Vanakkam. Good day. I read with considerable interest the above News. I was surprised and shocked to read that drugs are being recommended as the first line treatment. Based on my 50 years' experience in the medical field and extensive reading, I am fully convinced that Recommending drugs as a First line treatment is a retrograde step in the management of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. Food Modification is the only answer to uncomplicated Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
